info.title: BelGomla API
info.description: Every tenant lives on its own host ({tenant}.gomalecommerce.app); the host decides the tenant, never a header or payload. Auth is a Sanctum SPA cookie session: GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie first, then send the XSRF-TOKEN cookie back as the X-XSRF-TOKEN header. All text is Arabic, dates are ISO-8601 UTC and money is a "150.00" string.

parameters.name: entity_type
parameters.description: A table name, e.g. products, orders, sku_inventory

200.description: A page of audit entries, newest first

Category.name: category
Category.description: Category slug; its descendants are included. An unknown slug lists nothing.

Facets.name: f
Facets.description: `f[<field key>]=<option id | true | false | raw value>`, AND-combined, at most 20 (BR-P08).

Search.name: q
Search.description: Every word must match the folded name, a SKU code or a select option label (D32).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Retry-safe writes (D55); the same key with another body is idempotency_key_reused

CategoryIdFilter.name: category
CategoryIdFilter.description: Category id; its descendants are included

LowStock.name: low_stock
LowStock.description: Only SKUs whose available stock is at or below MOQ × conversion factor (D36)

DashboardCategoryTree.description: The root categories, each with its children

FieldDefinition.description: The field definition with its options

DashboardProduct.description: The product with SKU, tiers, stock, images and relations

BulkPricingResult.description: Affected count and the SKUs skipped for missing cover price

DashboardOrderDetail.description: The order with items, history and collections

ErrorCode.description: Every `error.code` the API emits (08 §0). A customer who is not active gets its status as the code.

message.description: Arabic text, safe to show as is.

details.description: Per-field messages on validation_failed; extra data on some codes (attempts_left, retry_after).

CategoryKind.description: The section of a root category, inherited by its subtree and products (D68). Decides what cover_price means: the printed cover price for books, the retail price otherwise

id.description: Select option id, or "true"/"false" for a boolean field; sent back as `f[<key>]=<id>`.

StoreSku.description: Quantities and MOQ are in the selling unit; `available` is in base units (D37). Price keys are left out when prices are hidden (D1); `available` is left out and `coming_soon` is true for a coming-soon product (D21).

prices_hidden.description: Present (true) only when the tenant hides prices from guests (BR-CU04).

phone.description: E.164; the customer's phone when none was given

removed_items.description: Lines removed because their product is no longer active, reported once (BR-P04).

LineProblem.description: One entry of `error.items` on checkout_failed and cart_line_invalid; quantities in selling units.

stale_pending_hours.description: Hours before a pending order is stale (D10)

SettingsRequest.description: Every key is optional; only the sent keys change

kind.description: The section this field applies to; null = every section (D69)
Bind the field to one section; null or absent = every section (D69)

custom_fields.description: Field key → option id (select), number, boolean or text

TierRequest.description: Send unit_price or discount_percent; the percentage wins when both are sent (BR-PR10)

PriceSetRequest.description: Send base_price or base_price_percent (off cover_price); the percentage wins (BR-PR10, D27)

skipped.description: Products whose status transition is not allowed (D29)

tiers.description: Replaces every SKU's tiers; an empty list removes them

batch_id.description: Apply only; the preview has none

min_allowed.description: The lowest on hand an adjustment may set: the reserved quantity (BR-INV08)
